title.zh: 将北甘马粦省卡帕隆阿市镇比纳万岸描笼涯Binawangan小学的名称变更为Marca Murillo小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Binawangan Elementary School in Barangay Binawangan, Municipality of Capalonga, Province of Camarines Norte, to Marca Murillo Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Binawangan Elementary School in Barangay Binawangan, Municipality of Capalonga, Province of Camarines Norte, to Marca Murillo Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Binawangan tại Barangay Binawangan, Đô thị Capalonga, Tỉnh Camarines Norte thành Trường Tiểu học Marca Murillo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Binawangan ในบารังไกย์ Binawangan เทศบาล Capalonga จังหวัด Camarines Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Marca Murillo
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Binawangan di Barangay Binawangan, Kotamadya Capalonga, Provinsi Camarines Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Marca Murillo
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Binawangan di Barangay Binawangan, Perbandaran Capalonga, Wilayah Camarines Norte kepada Sekolah Rendah Marca Murillo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6691_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Binawangan Elementary School in Barangay Binawangan, Municipality of Capalonga, Province of Camarines Norte, is hereby changed to Marca Murillo Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
